mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y/Y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate below 4% signals a tightening labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, as measured by the INDPRO index, signals a supply shock that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO drops by >2% MoM but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) rise by more than 10% year-over-year, it signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST rises by >10% Y/Y but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises by more than 0.5 percentage points over 3 months, it signals a weakening labor market that will negatively impact consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises by >0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) are both rising, it signals a tightening monetary policy with high inflation that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) is growing above 3% year-over-year and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a Goldilocks economy that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 Y/Y growth > 3% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.
